changelog.note: 121: Azure DI is called directly over its REST API when AZURE_DI_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DI_KEY are set (jav/adapters/azure_di.py; azure_di.api_version, azure_di.poll_interval_s); the legacy sidecar route stays for a machine without them. Before this, every document outside the legacy data folder failed before the network. An escalation that cannot run (no route, a failed call, an unknown outcome) now raises a to-do when the recipe's Azure switch is on. The cache key is unchanged: the new settings are not output settings, and the API version is the one every earlier Azure text was read with.

OCR-lanc (BACKLOG 7, B5): szoveg nelkuli PDF -> oldalkep (pypdfium2, 300 dpi, szurke) -> tesseract szo-dobozok (TSV) -> ugyanaz a sor- es cella-epito, mint a szovegreteges PDF-nel (jav/pdf.py). Motor: nativ tesseract (a gepen telepitett 5.4, a magyar + angol nyelvcsomag a regi sidecar Docker-kepebol, tools/tessdata), tartalek: a regi sidecar-kep (aiflow-v4-sidecar) docker run-nal, ha nincs nativ. A regi sidecar beallitasai: hun+eng, 200 dpi -> itt 300 dpi (a szamlareszletezo apro szamai miatt), psm 3 (automatikus oldalfelbontas). Lemez-gyorsitotar runs/ocr/ (doc sha256 + konfig-hash + tesseract-verzio a kulcsban).

076: azure_di.data_root removed; the sidecar's /data mount is the legacy project's data folder (JAV_LEGACY_ROOT, jav/config.py). The OCR cache key now covers only the settings that can change the recognised text (jav/ocr.py output_settings), so paths, time limits, notes and this version record do not invalidate it; the existing cache was moved to the new key once (python -m jav.cli ocr-rekey), with no new OCR.

escalation.note: a felhasznalo dontese (2026-09-20, handoff 013 §8): tesseract alapbol, Azure DI csak gyenge OCR-nel - a kuszobok (atlagos szo-bizalom / gyenge szavak aranya) a policy.json ocr.escalate_* mezoiben; a gyenge helyi OCR helyett az Azure-szoveg megy tovabb, mindketto a gyorsitotarban marad

docker.note: a regi 10_AIFLOW_V4 sidecar kepe (tesseract-ocr-hun + poppler); a gepen ~30x lassabb a nativnal (a VM sok kontenerrel osztozik), ezert csak tartalek

azure_di.note: Azure Document Intelligence (prebuilt-read), PAID and priced per page; never 'auto': only escalation, engine = azure_di or JAV_OCR_ENGINE=azure_di. 121: directly over the REST API when AZURE_DI_ENDPOINT and AZURE_DI_KEY are set (any readable document; timeout_s bounds the whole call, polling included); otherwise through the legacy sidecar's /parse (chain: azure_di; sidecar_url, container_root), which reads only PDFs under the legacy project's data folder (the container's /data mount; JAV_LEGACY_ROOT). Word geometry: polygons in inches, from the REST result or the sidecar's evidence file. A changed api_version gives the Azure texts a new cache key (jav/ocr.py engine_version).

quality.note: tesseract szo-bizalom (0-100) ez alatt = gyenge szo; a min_mean_conf / max_low_conf_ratio kuszobok a policy.json ocr blokkjaban (review-ok)
